name: eval-judge
title: Eval Judge
description: Judge for eval traces (ai-team#242/#244/#249). datasetRun mode reads a Langfuse dataset run, applies the versioned 6-dimension rubric plus deterministic schema-validity checks, writes append-only versioned scores back. online mode samples finished production apify-ai turns from a daily window and scores them with the online rubric (agent_judge scores). Idempotent re-runs; never starts the evaluated agent.
